brief: An open-source alternative to closed MikroTik-controller piso WiFi systems, for Filipino operators and hobbyists. It should feel open, trustworthy, local and simple to run.
criteria: Success: one mark that reads as a p and as a coin sending out wifi, works in one colour, survives at 16 px with the small cut, and stands apart from generic wifi-plus-peso marks.

concepts.name: Signal p
concepts.idea: The p's bowl is an O, the coin, and the coin at its centre sends out the wifi.
rationale: O and P merged into one letter: OpenPiso in a single glyph
Coin + signal = the product: drop a coin, get WiFi
Constructed wordmark from the same circles and stroke, no font licence needed
Separate small cut keeps the idea legible at 16 px

recommendation: Signal p, in OpenPiso greens: Forest for the letter, Mint (Leaf on white) for the coin and its signal.
next_steps: Run a trademark search (contactless-payment marks look similar)
Drop the web icons into the captive portal and admin UI
Print a vendo sticker test at actual size
